foreverpathways.configuration.title: Forever Pathways
foreverpathways.configuration.notices.to: What Pathways shows on your screen while you play. Only affects you.
A small popup at the side of the screen when a task or bounty moves forward.
config.foreverpathways.notices.banner.to: A short banner at the top of the screen when a task or bounty is complete. When off, a line in chat says so instead.
config.foreverpathways.notices.sound.too: A sound when a task or bounty is complete.
config.foreverpathways.difficulty.preset: Easy, Normal or Hard: starting shards, death penalties and node costs. Decided by the server.
